text:
emma_sales: FYI customer (FinHealth) requested a 45d on-prem POC for VPC/private deploy. Scope: 3-node, telemetry + optional KMS, staging only. Theywant platform fee waived during POC and either (a) apply POC fees as credit on conversion or (b) full first-month waiver. Also asking to split billing across two cost centers.
raj_dealdesk: Need exact dollar amount for the platform fee they want waived and the expected commit if they convert. Also require signed POC addendum with liability cap + data handling. Without that cannot approve.
emma_sales: Platform fee line on quote is $6,000/mo (standard). Customer asks full waiver for POC (45d pro-rated $9k) and conversion credit option. If they convert, they propose converting POC credit into the first invoice credit.
liam_se: From SE: 3-node config is fine. KMS test doable but on-prem keys will need wrapped key flow; that adds ~2 days of onboarding. Telemetry retention can be reduced to 30d in staging for the POC, but security signoff required to change default. No perf blockers.
noah_solutions: Security note: we need an explicit consent clause for telemetry during POC and a key exchange checklist for customer-managed keys. Recommend we require customer to run key wrapping sample to validate HSM integration.
olivia_finance: Split invoices OK but we require separate PO numbers and GL codes per BU before provisioning. Billing team needs a single payor or a remittance plan so we can link invoices; otherwise it delays provisioning. Also credits applied on conversion will affect revenue recognition; finance signoff needed.
legal-bot: Suggested clause: "Platform fee waived for POC; if customer executes a committed Dedicated agreement within 60 days of POC end, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to the waived platform fees to the first paid invoice. If no conversion within 60 days, waived fees are void."
raj_dealdesk: Conditional approval: I can approve the POC platform fee waiver (max 45d) if sales provides: signed POC addendum with clause above, expected committed spend (monthly $), PO numbers for both BUs, and a restart clause for auto-rebilling. Also require SLA exceptions documented.
emma_sales: Action items: 1) I'll send POC addendum with the legal clause + telemetry consent; 2) collect PO numbers and GL codes; 3) confirm expected commit $/mo.
liam_se: I'll draft a 1-page KMS/HSM onboarding runbook and telemetry toggle steps for staging. Tagging @noah_solutions to review.
olivia_finance: Once addendum + PO numbers received, finance will issue two invoices and set up credit mapping. Allow 48h processing.
raj_dealdesk: Please cc me on signed docs. If legal asks for higher liability cap we may need exec approval.
emma_sales: Will update thread when signed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
